name: 保存メッセージの完了と再通知
prompt:
Create the second render of the same Japanese saved-message row component. Keep the exact 390x160 canvas proportion, plain white background, all text, colors and visual style from the native preview and v001. This is a small alignment correction, not a redesign.

Preserve the exact content: muted context label 「みんなの相談」; mint circular avatar 「光」; bold sender 「ライトハウス」; message 「音声での打ち合わせが始まりました。」; forest-green pill 「完了にする」; outlined green information i button. No other rows or app chrome. No visible link text.

Adjust only the y positions and control sizes toward the native logical coordinates on 390x160: context label begins at x16 near y11; avatar at x16 y36 about 38px diameter; sender at x70 near y40; message at x70 near y72. Keep the message baseline near its current y72. Move the avatar/context/name cluster about 5px up from v001. Move both action controls down about 8px from v001 to x70 y112 and x210 y112. Set the complete pill to about 126x33 and the info button to about 48x34. Keep spacing between them and their existing green styling. Do not enlarge Japanese text.

Use the native preview as the exact authority for positions and sizes. Use v001 only to preserve the rendered design. Do not add blue text: this component contains no hyperlink.
reviewNotes: 第2版を実画像で目視。みんなの相談、光アバター、ライトハウス、本文、完了にする、情報アイコンを保持。表示リンクなし。v001よりコンテキストラベルとアバター位置はnativeに近づいた。native操作列はy112だがv002は約y104のまま（約8px上）。本文はnative付近。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
